name: CargoLoom
tagline: Freight infrastructure built for makers who ship what they make.
positioning: CargoLoom gives owner-operated workshops enterprise-grade shipping, provenance, and carrier logic without a full-time logistics team.

hero.h1: Ship handmade goods like a Fortune 500 logistics desk.
hero.sub: CargoLoom turns fragile, high-value, made-to-order inventory into a controlled shipping operation — carrier rates, insured provenance, and packing specs your two-person shop can actually run.

features.title: Provenance-grade manifests
features.description: Every crate ships with a signed record of maker, materials, and handling class — the paperwork galleries, wholesalers, and insurers keep asking your studio for.

features.title: Fragility-aware rate engine
features.description: Score each order by dimensions, breakability, and declared value, then compare live carrier quotes that already price in insurance and freight class.

features.title: Packing specs that scale
features.description: Codify how a specific piece gets wrapped, braced, and boxed once — then hand any bench assistant a repeatable spec instead of tribal knowledge.

features.title: Damage claim recovery
features.description: Auto-assemble photos, manifests, and carrier tracking into a claim packet the moment a delivery scan flags an exception. No more lost reimbursements.

features.title: Lead-time honesty
features.description: Bind production status to shipping estimates so the date a customer sees is the date they get — even when a kiln run slips a week.

features.title: Wholesale routing
features.description: Split a single studio batch into retail, wholesale, and consignment lanes with the right labels, terms, and documents on each pallet.

testimonials.quote: We used to lose a full afternoon a week reconstructing shipping paperwork for wholesale buyers. CargoLoom generates the manifest the moment a piece leaves the bench. That afternoon is back on the pottery wheel.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Osei

testimonials.quote: Damaged-in-transit used to mean eating the cost. Their claim packets got us three reimbursements last quarter that we'd have written off. It paid for the seats twice over.
testimonials.name: Daniel Reyes

testimonials.quote: I run a five-person glass studio, not a logistics department. CargoLoom lets my apprentices pack to spec and quote freight without me hovering over every crate.
testimonials.name: Priya Kalman

pricing.blurb: For solo makers formalizing how they ship their first wholesale orders.
For growing workshops running retail, wholesale, and consignment at once.
For multi-location makers and cooperatives with dedicated shipping staff.

homepage.footerBlurb: CargoLoom is shipping infrastructure for the people who still make things by hand. Own the craft. We'll own the crate.
